incidents.name: ROE Finance LP-collateral valuation
incidents.notes: ROE valued Uniswap V2 LP collateral from the pair's live reserves, so a flash-loaned 5.67M USDC swap through the WBTC/USDC pair moved the LP price and let the attacker borrow far more than the position was worth; the lending logic itself behaved as written.

sources.ref: onchain review: ROE 0x5F360c6b7B25DfBfA4F10039ea0F7ecfB9B02E60 created 2022-08-10T11:49:08Z by 0x7433d4158c702dc6bf0974e0bb4eea152cfbdd6a, unrelated to the attack sender; four EIP-1967 Upgraded events, the last on 2022-11-12T20:52:35Z (block 15956445, implementation 0x574ff39184dee9e46f6c3229b95e0e0938e398d0), so age runs from that upgrade (59.8 days) rather than the 154-day-old deployment. Loss netted from the tx receipt: 51,661.15 + 14,345.05 USDC out minus 26,024.07 USDC returned = 39,982.13 USDC (the 5,673,090.34 USDC leg is the Balancer flash loan, repaid in full).
